dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, who's the girl in this photo?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈhuːz ðə ˈɡɜːrl ɪn ðɪs ˈfoʊtoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's Jess. She's a friend I met at school in Canada.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈdʒɛs. ʃiːz ə ˈfrɛnd aɪ ˈmɛt ət ˈskuːl ɪn ˈkænədə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How did you get to know her?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ dɪd juː ˈɡɛt tə ˈnoʊ hɜːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We were in the same class. Now she's the person I trust most.
dialogue.reading: wiː wɜːr ɪn ðə ˈseɪm ˈklæs. ˈnaʊ ʃiːz ðə ˈpɜːrsən aɪ ˈtrʌst ˈmoʊst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, my closest friend. And who's the person you admire most, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, maɪ ˈkloʊsɪst ˈfrɛnd. ənd ˈhuːz ðə ˈpɜːrsən juː ədˈmaɪər ˈmoʊst, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My mom. She's my role model.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈmɑːm. ʃiːz maɪ ˈroʊl ˌmɑːdəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What do you admire about her?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ədˈmaɪər əˈbaʊt hɜːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's patient with every student she teaches, and she never gives up on them.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð ˈɛvri ˈstuːdənt ʃiː ˈtiːtʃɪz, ənd ʃiː ˈnɛvər ˈɡɪvz ˈʌp ɑːn ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I agree. Your mom is amazing!
dialogue.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː. jʊr ˈmɑːm ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ!
